validation_notes: The right side of the chart (mid-Jul to late-Jul) shows price consolidating in a fairly tight, roughly flat range between ~1850 and ~1950, not a converging wedge. Prior to this, price made a sharp decline from ~2400 to ~1550 (late May-June), then a rally back to ~1900, which doesn't set up a clean symmetric convergence pattern with multiple touchpoints on both converging sides. I don't see the apex-narrowing structure required for a credible triangle call.
